entries.zh: 随着对先进技术的掌握，我们对行政管理的要求也会扩大。必须熟练地满足我们迅速发展的帝国的需求。
entries.en: Our administrative requirements will likewise expand as our mastery of advanced technology evolves. We must adeptly cater to the demands of our burgeoning empire.

entries.zh: 我们的技术现在足以胜任任何管理要求，可以无缝管理星系帝国所需的所有专业知识。
entries.en: Our technology now surpasses any administrative requirement. The expertise needed to seamlessly govern a galactic empire is firmly within our reach.

entries.zh: 时间对这个格式塔思维毫不留情。在时间空泡中的长久续存已经钝化了它曾经充沛的生存渴望。
entries.en: Time has not been kind to this gestalt mind. A prolonged existence in a chrono-bubble dulled its once insatiable desire for survival.

entries.zh: 由于松弛的主脑几乎没有施加压力，这个帝国的子个体完成任务非常缓慢且看起来非常麻木。
entries.en: As the relaxed overmind exercises little pressure, this empire's drones almost look apathetic as they slowly fulfill their tasks.

entries.zh: 这个环世界古老的控制中心依靠着一大群无人机孜孜不倦的维护才能勉强为继。
entries.en: The ancient control center of the ringworld is barely maintained by the tireless efforts of a legion of machine drones.

entries.zh: 这座巨大的宫殿建筑群是一个早已逝去的时代的见证。尽管它富丽堂皇的外表拒绝屈服于时间的流逝，但许多翼殿都处于年久失修状态。
entries.en: This immense palatial complex is a testament to an era long gone. Despite its luminous facade refusing to succumb to the passage of time, many of its wings lay abandoned in various states of disrepair.

entries.zh: 该蜂巢霸权的古老枢纽正是无数代工蜂忠实执行指令的下达之地。
entries.en: This ancient nexus of the hive's supremacy is where uncountable generations of drones have dutifully executed directives.

entries.zh: 该中心使用先进的采购算法预测来满足物质需求，在民众意识到自己的需求之前就满足他们。
entries.en: This center anticipates and fulfills material desires using an advanced procurement algorithm, delivering satisfaction before the populace realizes their wants.

entries.zh: 这座中心可以毫不费力地在一瞬间实现任何最独特的欲望。
entries.en: This center effortlessly materializes the most outlandish desires at a moment's notice.

entries.zh: 复制科技可以如魔法般按照命令瞬间实现新潮风味。
entries.en: Replication technology swiftly conjures up novel flavors on command.

entries.zh: 你能想到的每种风味在这些建筑里都可以实现。
entries.en: Every conceivable flavor can be replicated within these walls.

entries.zh: 这些制造机的科技可以流畅地将能量转化为物质。
entries.en: This fabricator's technology achieves flawless conversion from energy to matter.

entries.zh: 这座先进的织造机不断地隧连进维度空间的织构中，提取出有价值的资源。
entries.en: This advanced fabricator seamlessly tunnels into the fabric of dimensional space, extracting valuable resources.

entries.zh: 能捕获这个奇点的全部能量输出是一项工程奇迹。
entries.en: Capturing the entire energy output from this singularity is an engineering marvel.

entries.zh: 该奇点的能量产出挑战着物理学的法则，而约束场又保持着极高的稳定性。
entries.en: This singularity's power output challenges the laws of physics, yet the containment fields hold with unwavering stability.

entries.zh: 该铸造厂产出的速率完全只受限于装入原材料的速度。
entries.en: This forge's production speed is limited only by the quantity of resources loaded into it.

entries.zh: 在这座锻炉中，巨大的纳米复制机以惊人的效率将原材料转化为先进的合金。
entries.en: The expansive nano-replicator bays in this forge transform raw materials into advanced alloys with marvelous efficiency.

entries.zh: 这座天空之城在尖端的反重力科技的推动下浮动，为其中的居民提供天堂般的居住环境。
entries.en: This floating city, propelled by state-of-the-art anti-gravity technology, provides an idyllic haven for its inhabitants.

entries.zh: 这些以重力消除科技悬浮着的穹顶超越了物理限制，先进的生命支持系统持续不断地满足居住者的需求。
entries.en: Suspended by gravimetric nullification, these domes transcend physical limitations, while advanced life support systems seamlessly cater to inhabitants' needs.

entries.zh: 这座硕大无朋的行星防御复合体具有无数的装甲和多层护盾。只有高度特化的攻城部队才有可能突破其防御。
entries.en: This colossal planetary defense complex has numerous armories and layers of shielding. Only a highly specialized siege force could breach its defenses.

entries.zh: 这座宏伟的行星防御复合体以无数的装甲和护盾强化，即便地崩山摧它的防御也不会陷落
entries.en: This monumental planetary defense complex protects with countless armories and shielding; the planet's mountains will crumble before its defenses.

entries.zh: 这个储存库容纳着自数个星系纪元积累下的知识，然而用于操作它的奥术检索系统已经失传。仅是从中提取出的只言片语也是无价的。
entries.en: This repository houses knowledge from multiple galactic ages, yet the ability to operate its arcane retrieval system is lost. Extracted data scraps prove invaluable.

entries.zh: 这座神殿专用于与虚境灵体沟通，它只有一小部分存在于我们的维度当中。
entries.en: Exclusively used for communing with the spirits of the Shroud, this temple manifests only partially in our dimension.

entries.zh: 在这个巨大的装置上挂着一排排的冷冻荚仓，里面装着数十亿具消逝已久的外星人的冷冻遗骸。
entries.en: Rows upon rows of cryo-pods line this massive structure, containing the long-expired remains of billions of alien specimens frozen long ago.

entries.zh: 作为横跨星系的官僚系统的一部分，这座庞大的复合体与一个无边无际的行政网络相连。
entries.en: Integral to a galaxy-spanning bureaucratic system, this extensive complex is connected to a vast administrative network.

entries.zh: 这座庞大的复合体是一个横跨星系的官僚系统的中心，与一座强韧且先进的行政网络相连。
entries.en: This extensive complex, the centerpiece of a galaxy-spanning bureaucratic system, coordinates a robust and advanced administrative network.

entries.zh: 这个感知节点网络在高度专业化的子个体精心照料下，巩固起了蜂巢对其广阔认知领域的统治。
entries.en: Carefully tended by highly specialized drones, this network of ephaptic nodes fortifies the Hive's dominion over its expansive cognitive domain.

entries.zh: 这个广博的感知节点网络在高度专业化的子个体精心照料下，在全星系范围贯彻着蜂巢的意志。
entries.en: Carefully tended by highly specialized drones, this vast network of ephaptic nodes fortifies the Hive's will over the galaxy.

entries.zh: 一座先进的分形接线器，以近乎瞬时的精度无缝处理并传输数万亿的信号。
entries.en: An advanced fractal hub, seamlessly processing and transmitting trillions of signals with near instantaneous precision.

entries.zh: 一座先进的量子纠缠集线器，精确地处理并瞬间传输千万亿的信号。
entries.en: An advanced quantum entanglement hub, processing and instantaneously transmitting quadrillions of signals precisely.

entries.zh: 形而上学技术的尖端进步让奉献者与圣灵得以直接交流。
entries.en: Cutting-edge advancements in metaphysical technology grant devotees a direct communion with the divine essence.

entries.zh: 将形而上学科技应用到灵能布道中可以放大心灵共鸣。这座巨大的综合体使奉献者能够在整个星系范围内与圣灵紧密相连。
entries.en: Using metaphysical technology for psionic sermons amplifies spiritual resonance. This immense complex enables worshippers to intimately connect to the divine essence at a system-wide range.

entries.zh: 一座由技艺精湛的机器人专家操作的前卫装配综合体，该设施超越了传统的界限，一丝不苟地实现了机器人创新的前沿。
entries.en: An avant-garde assembly complex manned by expert Roboticists, this facility transcends conventional bounds, meticulously realizing the forefront of robotic innovation.

entries.zh: 这座设施就是工程学道德奇迹，它的量子化组装线使用纠缠转换器将机器零件加工到最细微的细节。没有一个原子错位。
entries.en: A marvel in engineering, this facility's quantic assembly line uses entanglement converters to craft machine parts down to the most minute detail. Not a single atom is misplaced.

entries.zh: 分子焕活所深入研究细胞的复杂性、提高医疗效率，从而显著提高人口的健康质量和预期寿命。
entries.en: Molecular-Revitalization Institutes delve deep into cellular intricacies to amplify the effectiveness of medical treatments, significantly improving the quality and longevity of the populations' health.

entries.zh: 生物再生研究所是医疗技术的巅峰，是开创性生物再生疗法的先驱，他们不断重新定义延长生命的界限。
entries.en: The Bioregeneration Institute, at the pinnacle of medical technology, pioneers groundbreaking bio-regenerative therapies, continuously redefining the boundaries of life extension.

entries.zh: 这座雄伟的法务大厦将法院和执法部门完美地结合在了一起。
entries.en: This massive judicial complex seamlessly intertwines courts and law enforcement.

entries.zh: 作为最顶尖的法律机构，这座雄伟的建筑是一座正义的丰碑，内设法院、拘留所和教养所，即使是最顽固的罪犯也会改过自新。
entries.en: The zenith of legal institutions, this colossal edifice is a monument to justice, harboring courts, holding facilities, and correctional facilities that will redeem even the most hardened criminals.

entries.zh: 高耸的塔尖俯视着天际线，向繁华的商业区投下阴影。
entries.en: Dominating the skyline, these towering spires cast shadows across the bustling trade districts below.

entries.zh: 这个贸易区划在星系贸易中占据着至高无上的地位，甚至从轨道上都能看到它的巨大尖顶。
entries.en: Reigning supreme in the galactic economy, the colossal spires of this trade district can be seen from orbit.

entries.zh: 这座仓库可以部分影响分子间距，有效地减小了一切存储于此的物体的尺寸。生物禁止进入。
entries.en: The depot influences a portion of subspace where the distance between molecules is reduced, effectively shrinking anything stored there. Living beings are forbidden from entering it.

entries.zh: 我们可以通过创造一个局部口袋维度来存储几乎无尽的资源。
entries.en: By creating a localized pocket dimension, we can hold nearly endless resources.

entries.zh: 这些庞大的娱乐区段是娱乐休闲的最前沿。脑波阅读技术可以创造即时、个性化的虚拟度假体验。
entries.en: These immense entertainment sectors are at the forefront of recreation and leisure. Brainwave readers allow for instantaneous and personalized virtual getaways.

entries.zh: 这是娱乐的顶峰，这座枢纽超越常规的限制，在这里，所有的愿望在许下之前就已经实现了。
entries.en: A colossal culmination of entertainment, this nexus transcends conventional limits, where dreams materialize before desires are realized.

entries.zh: 这座枢纽拥有最先进的设备和能力无与伦比的员工，开创了一个不仅可以探索量子理论、而且可进行突破性应用的时代。
entries.en: This nexus boasts state-of-the-art equipment and an unprecedented staff capacity, ushering in an era where quantum theories are not just explored but harnessed for groundbreaking innovation.

entries.zh: 建筑这座建筑是科学进步的顶点，见证着这个无限创新的时代。
entries.en: This building is the apex of scientific advancement and proves this is an era of boundless innovation.

entries.zh: 这座采矿工厂可以透过行星地幔找到所有的矿物，使用量子隧穿技术在没有物理接触的情况下钻穿固体材料。
entries.en: This mining plant can find minerals anywhere in this planet's mantle using quantum tunneling technology to bore through solid materials without physical contact.

entries.zh: 这座采矿中心使用量子隧穿科技可以在不进行物理接触的前提下透过固液物体、从该行星上地核以上的所有位置提取矿物
entries.en: This mining hub can extract minerals anywhere down to the planet's outer core using quantum tunneling technology to bore through solid or liquid materials without physical contact.

entries.zh: 少数坚定派拒绝奢靡的生活，热心公共服务。要靠他们来监督和指导这个古老文明的余民。
entries.en: The stalwart few have rejected lives of luxury in favor of public service. It is up to them to oversee and guide the remnants of their ancient civilization.

entries.zh: 这些远古机器居住于环形世界内，不知疲倦地维护并修理环形世界老旧的机械结构。
entries.en: These ancient machines tirelessly maintain and repair the decaying machinery of the ringworld on which they reside.

entries.zh: 这些古老的机器永恒地守护着数十亿在低温冷冻中的智慧生体。
entries.en: These ancient machines maintain a ceaseless vigil over the expired remains of billions of cryogenically frozen sapients.

entries.zh: 非常富裕的生活，所有一切的物质需求和欲望都能得到满足。
entries.en: A life of total opulence, where every possible material need or desire can be satisfied.

entries.zh: 必须将每个数据片段进行归档、编目，并建立索引。一切都应按照数个纪元前第一管理员所设立的古代仪式进行。
entries.en: Each data fragment must be filed, cataloged, and indexed precisely according to the ancient rites established eons ago by the First Librarian.

entries.zh: 卡萨吉尔曾用来割去三咒之魔的毒尾、用来避免饥荒的，难道不正是犁这种高贵的工具吗?
entries.en: Was it, not the plow, this noblest of instruments, that Kazargiel used to sever the poisonous tail of the thrice-cursed demon and stave off famine?

entries.zh: 圣·马萨库尔举起圣焰战锤，狠狠地将第一恶魂的头颅一劈为二，劈出了通往水晶的道路。
entries.en: And with one mighty blow, Saint Mazakudal used her burning hammer to split the skull of the First Wraith in two, opening up the path to the crystals.

entries.zh: 同时也不要忘记圣钳，在黑暗即将笼罩世界之时，圣光巴扎尔就是用它控制了阳光。
entries.en: Remember also the hyper spanner and how it was used by Bazagg the Shining to tame the sun when it seemed like darkness would overtake the world.

entries.zh: 于是阿茲纳卡对从者们说道，“到圣坊里去吧，用你们的技艺创造你们追寻的未来”。
entries.en: And so Aznakha said to the acolytes, 'Go to the workshops, and form with your crafts the future you seek'.

entries.zh: 为了让大部分人安居乐业享受美好生活，这些强韧的个体会昼警夕惕以暴制暴对付不法分子。
entries.en: So that the majority can rest peacefully and enjoy their lives of extravagance, these rough individuals stand ready in the night to visit violence on those who would do them harm.

entries.zh: 大音希声。若想悟得此中真意，必需翱翔于癫狂的峭壁边缘。
entries.en: It speaks, but not in words. To divine any meaning, one must hover on the precipice of madness.

entries.zh: 那一刻，在空中，未来降生。那光芒炫目无比，但仍有少数人可以直视光芒，看透其后之景。他们将指引世人的职责引为己任。
entries.en: And it was there, in the sky, that the future was born. The light was blinding, but a few could see past it. They took it upon themselves to lead others forward.

entries.zh: 这些生物标本被运送来这个宜居的生态环境中生活，以确保其物种得以在这个混乱而危险的宇宙中延续下去。
entries.en: These specimens have been gathered here, in settings that approximate their natural environments, to ensure the preservation of their species in an often chaotic and destructive galaxy.

entries.zh: 这些先驱监护者负责照顾其管辖的异种监护区。
entries.en: These precursor zookeepers look after the needs of the Xeno-Wards under their care.
